25jj:
This Ravensbourne University London course looks at the communication between movement and narrative. One of the leading animation courses in the country and the only one of its kind in London; the course will help students to apply animation skills to a broad range of careers by using a mix of practice and theory-based learning. It encourages students to respond to live and self-initiated briefs, to solve creative problems. The course involves a mix of practice and theory-based learning, including lectures, seminars, workshops, individual tutorials and self-directed study. Students will have access to industry standard software and will produce an assessed portfolio of creative and professional work.

Key study topics include: Contemporary culture, Animation fundamentals, Modelling to camera, Human and creature mechanic, Visual narrative, Animation industry, and more.

Animation is an increasingly widespread form of media and good animators are becoming more sought after in film, television, VFX, gaming and the web. Animation graduates often go on to secure work as 3D/2D generalists as well as specialists in areas including: concept, modelling, animation and VFX production. Past graduates have been employed in roles within film and television, visual effects, advertising, post-production, apps and games.
25k4:
This advertising and brand design degree course will give students the skills to develop a critical and contextual understanding of advertising and brand design. Working collaboratively with others, students will learn how the industry is being transformed by emerging digital technologies and discover innovative ways to solve creative problems. Students may work with massive brands like Apple, through the course's unrivalled industry links.

Students ‘learn with industry’ engaging with professional practice throughout the course. In the last three years, Ravensbourne University London has worked with global brands like Apple, Sky, Barclays Bank and The O2 and leading studios such as Moving Brands, Studio Blup, Kin+Carta and JKR. Most recently, Ravensbourne University London was privileged to work with Apple on an exhibition called Unsigned Stories, which is featured below.

This advertising and branding degree investigates how visual stories are deployed to bring products and services to life. Students examine diverse areas of marketing, branding and advertising, including: how to develop brand communication, social media content, marketing strategy and interactive experience. Students will also learn to create graphic design communication for contemporary media platforms.

Students will construct stories that connect strategically across print, social and online channels to engage audiences and influence perception. As well as exploring cutting-edge, such as apps, digital print, online media and mobile games, students will also examine traditional communication formats, like print-based media. This degree in advertising really will provide students with a solid grounding.

Creative advertising, social media, digital technology, communication, storytelling and brand design are all prominent branches on the all-encompassing marketing tree. They are also decisive factors in what makes many contemporary companies successful and stand out from the crowd. As such, when students graduate with a BA honours degree in Advertising and Brand Design at Ravensbourne University London, they will not just be given a robust foundation to help them move into their chosen field of expertise. Students will also boost their all-round employability, developing a diverse skill-set that is highly transferable.
25jm:
Through this architecture degree course, students will take inspiration from art, philosophy and technology to explore the spaces and places they inhabit. With access to gold-standard facilities and the highest-caliber teaching, students will develop their own creative vision by exploring the role architecture plays in shaping the society.

In graduating from this esteemed architecture course in London, students will possess multidisciplinary knowledge and vital transferable skills, which will prepare them for a career within the many threads of architecture. These include: urban design, housing and office design, planning, building conservation, architectural heritage and community development.
90el:
Bachelor of Arts (Honours) - Business Management with Fashion is designed for those seeking careers in business, with a particular focus on fashion in a global context. The creative flair and networks that Ravensbourne University fosters enable students to collaborate with like-minded peers, business practitioners, and educators to better understand, innovate, and research in these areas.

Accordingly, the BSc (Hons) Business Management with Fashion engages students in real-world business explorations while simultaneously offering transferable skill development opportunities, emphasising those that will support their chosen career paths. This insightful degree delivers collaborative core business practice alongside refined skills in management, strategy, and research, which support and enhance students’ journeys into the ever-evolving fashion business landscape.

Embedded within the course are key themes that, from both present and future standpoints, challenge and animate creativity in business and creative enterprise. These themes — the Four Pillars of the BSc (Hons) Business Management with Fashion — are: (i) Innovation, (ii) Creative Perspectives, (iii) Ethics, Social Responsibility, and Sustainability, and (iv) Future Perspectives. Each of these pillars is integrated across all course modules.
6fe8:
This practice-led course uniquely prepares students for entry into the rapidly changing field of contemporary illustration. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and strong industry links, the course will enable students to sharpen their skills and promote their craft.

Students will explore ideas and themes across commercial, social, political, and cultural contexts, utilising narratives in compelling and innovative ways.

Ravensbourne will prepare students to be experimental and creative practitioners, equipped to work across different media and formats. The course is informed by illustration’s rich heritage and yet is forward-thinking in its understanding of the application of contemporary illustration in the 21st century. It will turn illustrators into contemporary visual storytellers and help them to find their individual visual voice. Students will explore and apply their skills across a range of illustrative applications including: editorial, publishing, packaging, product, print, advertising, character and film.

This course crosses many creative boundaries with opportunities within multiple sectors including graphic design, advertising, publishing, fashion, product design, animation and games design.
6fe0:
Successful content creation can be game changing for brands, enhancing their visibility and enabling them to connect with audiences worldwide. On this course in digital content creation, learn how to build long-term awareness and engagement.

Become part of Ravensbourne’s creativity community, and learn the skills required to develop film and digital content to create powerful campaigns. Support business and marketing strategies for brands and companies and build solid entrepreneurial skills.

Ravensbourne is a pioneer in the creative application of digital technologies. Students will learn the creative and conceptual skills required to produce digital content to create powerful campaigns. These can be used to support marketing strategies for brands of all sizes, as well as individuals who want to communicate their ideas to the public. By the end of the course, students will have built up an impressive portfolio of digital content creation skills and already have a wealth of experience working with clients.

The modules on this BA (Hons) Digital Content Creation course enable students to gradually build their creative, conceptual and digital content skills and enable them to enhance their long-term career or future academic choices.

Students will always be encouraged to network and make contacts for the future, and there will be opportunities to work on live briefs for clients. Students will develop their communication skills through pitches, and use industry-standard professional equipment and software to produce high-quality content.
25k8:
The Digital Film Production program combines the main elements of film production, screenwriting and film theory. Students will learn how to augment stories through digital film productions, utilizing cutting-edge technologies.

Taking a holistic and practical approach, students will explore the professional aspects of filmmaking. The course is underpinned by the film industry and will give them the skills and experience to produce innovative film shorts, features, commercials and documentaries.

In this film and television production course at Ravensbourne University London, students will cover all aspects of the digital film production journey – from financial backing to building a fan base. With an emphasis on hands-on training, they will have access to high specification digital cameras, Steadicams, dolly systems and green screens to hone their technical skillset. Students will be granted access to high-end computer labs loaded with the latest digital applications for post-production editing.

Taught through a blend of practice and theory-based learning, which includes lectures, workshops, seminars and self-directed study, the BA (Hons) Digital Film Production degree is led by production and broadcast experts with excellent industry experience.

This exciting film and TV production degree is divided into two distinct pathways: film production and operations. The production strand is tailored to those who want to make innovative television programming using a variety of distribution platforms, including social media. The operations avenue will teach students about varied film production techniques and digital operations, including the use of media asset management systems.
25ju:
The Digital Photography program is the destination for budding contemporary photographers who wish to push the boundaries of a powerful medium. Accredited by the Association of Photographers (AOP) and the Royal Photographic Society (RPS), students will learn to decipher creative briefs, develop their own photographic style and prepare collections for exhibitions and competitions.

This industry-focused photography degree provides an education in the broader areas of digital photographic practice and will instill an understanding of the rapidly changing principles and methods that underpin new and emerging creative commercial practice.

Students will use practical skills, knowledge and critical application of digital photography, helping them to explore the creative potential of their camera. Through a mix of practice and theory-based learning, they will be taught to think like a photographer and explore how images are created, shared, distributed and sold.

The program is designed to combine practical skills with a knowledge of the critical application of digital photography. Students will explore the creative potential of the camera and the theories and movements that drive change.

Students will be encouraged to develop their own distinctive portfolio to showcase a high level of technical skill, whilst understanding the theory of photography, as well as seek opportunities for placements at top London agencies and photographers. They will also be encouraged to work collaboratively with other students across the college and different disciplines.
5e93:
Ravensbourne University London's Design Communication master's degree will enable you to produce industry-quality graphic design, marketing, social media and digital technology assets.

In this exciting new MA Design Communication course, students will gain the knowledge, confidence and professional acumen to creatively position services, systems and need-driven design products.

Students will respond to societal and user needs to expand their graphic communication design skills. Students will be immersed in the tools and processes of digital design and emerging technologies, whilst exploring the value of design thinking and services in a bustling marketplace.

During the course, students will establish a critical design practice, create dynamic interacting spaces, and apply design to respond to a range of needs. Students will engage their target audiences by synthesising creativity with sound business theories – an essential skill that will boost their employability across many potential career avenues.

After studying for the MA Design Communication course, students will have:

  • The hands-on design thinking skills to turn creative visions into truly engaging assets
  • The business and commercial acumen to reach and inspire audiences across all business, international and not-for-profit sectors
  • The confidence to generate real change and influence decision making at the most senior levels
68yk: This MA Design Management course offers a range of interdisciplinary perspectives from business, technology, social enterprises and new venture creation. It offers practical research and work-based projects in all areas shaping the creative economy and the fourth industrial revolution – including the role of creative interventions in technology-enabled business transformation, change management and design leadership.
6fdy:
On this MA/MFA Digital Photography course in London, UK, students will look at image making as a modern platform for communication and explore the role that technology plays in shaping the industry, both in the present and future.

Students will examine relevant media platforms and formats to explore the dissemination and distribution of the digital image.

Students' work will integrate traditional lens-based practices with the contemporary, delving into the likes of computational photography, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning and augmented reality (AR). Students will develop and enhance their skills within a series of diverse projects that run through the course. The variety of the modules will enable students to work within a commercial environment, utilise recognised strategies and workflows and create a body of work that showcases the breadth of their ability and potential.

The course benefits from the university's strong industry reputation and places an emphasis on innovation. It will enable students to develop a more independent approach to study and to gain a greater understanding of the industry and the various career pathways within it. Students will be part of a diverse community of creatives, working collaboratively to explore new professional practices. Ravensbourne has strong industry links with a range of high-profile companies, this has previously included the likes of: Apple, Barclays, the BBC, European Space Agency, Marks & Spencer, Museum of London, the Royal Shakespeare Company, Samsung and many more.

With this the student will develop the advanced knowledge to create and implement complex designs and technology projects. Student will explore systems and platforms for communication, responsive content creation, visualisation, and learn experimental approaches to tackle your work. The student will investigate and realise radical project proposals through collaborative interactions with both peers and industry, and explore the latest advancements in technologies such as AI, Web3, digital fashion, metaverse asset realisation, AR, VR and XR.
25ke:
Throughout the MA Illustration course in London, students will explore the roles of illustration today and its wide-ranging professional applications moving forward. They will experiment across narrative and storytelling methods, which will enable them to present and reposition information in a strategic, accessible and engaging fashion.

Students will examine complex knowledge, data and information and bring it to life with empathy, which will free them to tell stories that need to be told and ensure that no message is lost in translation.

Students can join the new MA Illustration course in Ravensbourne University London's new flagship building, The Institute for Creativity and Technology, where creative minds prosper. By taking on consultancy and organizational roles, as well as developing their own illustration practice, this master's program is designed to make them truly industry ready.
61pz:
This programme is ideal for graduates and professionals who are looking to progress their career and advance their standing in business and the creative industries.

During this MBA at Ravensbourne University London, students will develop global perspectives, broaden their horizons and become experts in evaluating current challenges in business management. During the course, students will take an in-depth look at business management and administration and will participate in a collaborative working environment. Through a series of business lectures and classes taught by industry and academic professionals, they will develop a varied skill-set to enable them to progress their career in business and management. Students will be pushed outside of their comfort zone to enhance their leadership skills and be put to the test through simulated tasks emulating real world practice.

They will study in a supportive environment with like-minded individuals who can share their ideas and vision. This versatile MBA in business administration will support and prepare students for progression into a variety of sectors and roles. Graduates often secure roles within the areas of consulting, finance and investment, technology, analysis, operations and human resource management (HRM).
9h49:
The Ravensbourne MBA is a future-oriented, evidence-led postgraduate programme designed for professionals aspiring to lead with impact in today’s fast-paced, interconnected, and technology-driven world.

Combining academic rigour with practical insight, the MBA equips participants with the knowledge, tools, and mindset required to make confident, responsible, and innovative decisions across diverse industries. Through a dynamic curriculum grounded in real-world relevance, participants engage with contemporary global business challenges through simulations, live case studies, consultancy-style projects, and an applied capstone research experience.

At the core of the programme is the Ravensbourne 5Cs Framework, a distinctive model for leadership and professional development built around five critical capabilities:

  • Commercial Competence: Mastery of business fundamentals to drive sustainable growth and strategic advantage.
  • Confidence: The ability to lead decisively in complex and evolving contexts.
  • Communication: Clear and persuasive engagement with a range of stakeholders.
  • Compassion: Ethical leadership grounded in inclusivity, empathy, and social responsibility.
  • Creative Commitment: The use of innovation and design thinking to solve problems and deliver value in a sustainable and profitable manner.

Throughout the programme, participants apply evidence-based approaches to decision-making and problem-solving, using data and insights to support strategic action.

Assessment is 100% coursework-based and includes a rich mix of presentations, analytical reports, collaborative projects, and industry-facing research tasks designed to reflect real-world business practice and leadership challenges.

The Ravensbourne MBA develops agile, confident, and ethically grounded leaders capable of thriving in a rapidly changing global economy and shaping the future of business with purpose and creativity.
9gea:
The MBA with Business Transformation is designed for professionals seeking to lead change, improve organisational performance and respond to rapidly evolving business environments. Combining strategic business management with specialist knowledge in transformation and innovation, the course develops the skills needed to navigate organisational change and deliver long-term business improvement.

Students will study core MBA disciplines such as strategic management, evidence-based decision-making, stakeholder influence and measuring business success, while also exploring business strategy and digital transformation and sustainable approaches to project delivery. The course encourages students to consider how organisations can adapt to disruption, embrace digital innovation and implement transformation strategies that create sustainable value.

The final project enables students to apply their learning to a real-world organisational challenge, investigating opportunities for business development, operational change or innovation.
9ge9:
The MBA with Cyber Security Management combines advanced business leadership with specialist knowledge in cyber security strategy and organisational risk management. Designed for professionals interested in the intersection between technology, governance and business resilience, the course prepares students to understand how organisations can respond to digital threats while maintaining effective operations and strategic growth.

Alongside core MBA modules focused on business strategy, stakeholder management and performance measurement, students will explore cyber security principles and strategic cyber security management. The course examines how organisations identify vulnerabilities, manage cyber risks and develop policies that support secure and sustainable business practices.

Through the final project, students can investigate a contemporary cyber security or digital risk challenge, applying business management concepts to real-world organisational scenarios.
